comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
"2 of them are better used in maritime work than turn to a spear"

This isn't how memorial albums work. When you have the item drop, it gets recorded in the album, but whether you use, sell or throw away the item, it still counts for the album.

3 of the items are fairly rare, but I don't see that as a big factor. People who run FSD (and particularly lower) run it a lot. They'll get the drops sooner or later.

People that run FSD lower enough to have a shot at this album probably have far better weapons than this MA reward. Price is going to be based on the fact that each character can only get one of these, ever.
